#  The octets each MOVED vector had *before* the milestone that moved it.
#
#  Written by hand from the previous milestone's published corpus -- for these
#  nine, commit ac6dc37, whose corpus digest was
#  48303fa583a391ce789e83a6f9a775d9c6e2b1a634fd67c8a5076b6fcd493ea3.
#
#  ``frozen_corpus.txt`` alone can only say THAT a vector moved.  These rows are
#  what let a test say HOW: the predecessor and the successor are decoded and
#  compared as trees, and the movement has to be confined to digest-valued
#  leaves.  A milestone that changed a tag, an arity, an atom or a set's
#  membership while reporting 'only digests moved' fails against these rows and
#  passes against a one-column ledger.
#
#  A vector that has never moved has no row here.  When a future milestone moves
#  one, its pre-move octets are added here and its row in frozen_corpus.txt is
#  updated -- two edits, in one diff, with the ratified cause beside them.
